Overview

Valmiera is a city in Valmiera with a population of 25,000. A charming town in the Gauja River valley, known for the Valmiera Castle ruins, the Valmiera Drama Theatre, and proximity to the Gauja National Park. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
